column3: Manami Route · On the Way Home with Kyou-chan
The 3-day, 2-night field trip ended safely.
I was struggling to walk on the way home with Manami.
Kyou-chan, you look tired.
While you look quite energetic instead.
Yes! I was thinking that I would've liked to stay another night.
Well, Kyoto is perfect for grannies. Since they're both old...
Hm? Did you say something, Kyou-chan?
No, it's nothing. Anyway, for today, go home and get some rest.
Okay, thank you. You too.
Looking at Manami's usual smile, it's somehow reassuring.
Rather, it feels like I'm back to my ordinary life.
Since up till now, it was probably that the school trip was out of the ordinary.
Kyou-chan, is something wrong?
Huh? Oh, I'm just thinking that seeing your vacant expression is kind of soothing.
R-Really!? I'm glad～
Nah, it's not really a compliment...
But seeing me calms you down, right?
Well, I guess so.
Then, that is a compliment～. Hehehe...
As always, this girl gets flustered from the weirdest things.
Well, I don't particularly dislike that part of you.
Or rather, don't pick up any new quirks and stay like that for me.
Hm? Stay like what?
Ah, it's nothing.
Really? Then, that's fine...
And she's as sincere as always.
A soothing atmosphere... I wonder if that's what I'm unconsciously looking for?
As we were walking while chatting, we reached the street where we usually part ways...
B-By the way! Kyou-chan!
Hm? What is it?
Are you free tomorrow?
Tomorrow? I don't really have anything planned so yeah. Also, stop fidgeting, it's creepy.
I-I'm not fidgeting! Geez, Kyou-chan (><)!
Sorry, sorry. So, what's up?
...There's something I want to talk about.
Well, I don't mind. School... isn't a good idea, huh? Then... How about on the way back home tomorrow? Around the park.
Y-Yes. Th-Then let's do that.
Okay, got it.
S-See you tomorrow then, Kyou-chan.
...It can't be.
Don't tell me she also...?
Nah, she would be the last person for that.
